sql: WITH RECURSIVE net AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions WHERE txn_type IN ('deposit','withdrawal') GROUP BY customer_id,m), bounds AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(m) first_m,MAX(m) last_m FROM net GROUP BY customer_id), spine(customer_id,m,last_m) AS (SELECT customer_id,first_m,last_m FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT customer_id,date(m,'+1 month'),last_m FROM spine WHERE m<last_m), filled AS (SELECT s.customer_id,s.m,s.last_m,COALESCE(n.net,0) net FROM spine s LEFT JOIN net n ON s.customer_id=n.customer_id AND s.m=n.m), closing AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY m ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) balance FROM filled), previous AS (SELECT *,LAG(balance,1,0) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY m) prior_balance FROM closing), latest AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN prior_balance=0 THEN balance*100.0 ELSE (balance-prior_balance)*100.0/prior_balance END growth FROM previous WHERE m=last_m) SELECT 'full_population' kind,COUNT(*) n,SUM(growth>5) above5,100.0*SUM(growth>5)/COUNT(*) pct FROM latest UNION ALL SELECT 'intermediate_missing_months',COUNT(*),NULL,NULL FROM filled f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM net n WHERE n.customer_id=f.customer_id AND n.m=f.m) UNION ALL SELECT 'customers_without_selected_transactions',COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id),NULL,NULL FROM customer_transactions WHERE customer_id NOT IN(SELECT customer_id FROM bounds)
